description: Muse Spark D-MLP (the DFlash2 draft layer's MLP half) at TP8 for one draft step (a block of 8 rows a request, run as a TARGET_VERIFY batch): rows = requests x 8 draft tokens at the compiled widths 8, 16, 32 and 64 (1, 2, 4 and 8 requests; 8 and 16 are the default served widths, 32 and 64 are under test upstream). The kernel's work does not depend on the context. Width weights from the AgentX corpus (cc-traces-weka-062126) in-flight request distribution at concurrency 1, 2, 4 and 8; derived from corpus statistics, not yet confirmed by a live capture. Production-range span exemption: the model fixes every other dimension and the served rows span 8x (workload_evidence.json). rows = 24 is a correctness-only boundary case.
